hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT NOR firmware FIT kernel #28
inputs.revision: Written at firmware offset 0x20000; flash verification passed; normal boot used this FIT.

inputs.name: LittleFS network root for kernel #28
inputs.revision: 10 MiB at offset 0x600000; flash verification passed; normal boot reached the configured network startup.

inputs.name: Strict SAE profile
inputs.revision: Required PMF configured locally; profile identifiers and credentials omitted.

inputs.name: EmberBSD connected-scan and roam probe script

scenario: On one operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample, verify normal boot and strict-SAE baseline, one connected scan with baseline continuity, one requested roam to a fresh compatible alternate, and local mDNS address-record state.
expected: Normal boot reaches the configured network; strict SAE is completed before and through the connected scan; an accepted roam completes a new authorized association; mDNS address records are registered and observable on the network.
observed: Both the kernel #28 FIT and 10 MiB LittleFS root were written with flash verification. Normal boot reached the configured rc/network path. The strict-SAE baseline reported WPA_COMPLETED and IPv4. The probe recorded the same baseline BSSID, SSID and security at scan_start and scan_end; it observed no lifecycle transition, SAE callback or disconnect between those markers. A fresh compatible alternate was selected. The supplicant accepted one ROAM request, but the new join (generation 4) reported scan error 0x3006 and SAE error 70, then teardown began. The probe ended FAIL deadline with final state DISCONNECTED; a completed roam was not observed. A local mDNS state dump contained host A and PTR records while AutoTargetServices was 0, but target TX/RX counters were 0/0, so on-network advertisement or response was not verified. This is one bounded connected-scan result, not a successful full roam.

measurements.unit: none observed in the bounded marker interval

measurements.name: roam-teardown-observed

measurements.name: mdns-network-advertisement-response-verified
measurements.unit: not verified; no network response observed

limits: One operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample and one bounded kernel #28 run; other revisions are not established.
The connected scan preserved sampled baseline state between scan markers in this run; this does not establish general connected-scan reliability.
ROAM control acceptance did not establish a completed transition; the probe ended with the supplicant DISCONNECTED.
802.11k/v/r and BTM/RRM behavior were not validated.
mDNS A/PTR records were present in the local daemon dump, but target TX/RX counters were zero and an on-network response was not verified.
WPA2-PSK, strict-SAE connectivity, DHCP, DNS and basic reachability were verified in earlier bounded runs; those results are not measurements from this kernel #28 run.
No forged-frame protection, throughput, or sustained-reliability test was completed.
